text: If a private fund's offering process successfully limits its investors to accredited investors or qualified purchasers, the retail investor protection principles of the Company Act do not apply to the fund's trading, operation, and governance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: Accordingly, if a private fund's offering process successfully limits its investors to either "accredited investors" or "qualified purchasers," the retail investor protection principles of the Company Act will not apply to the private fund's trading, operation, and governance.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: private funds relying on Sections 3(c)(1) or 3(c)(7)
